items.title: Share these readings with your care team
items.text: Only 58.8% of your readings were in the target range, and your average was 181.9 mg/dL. Bring this to your next visit to discuss.

items.title: Try a 10 to 20 minute walk after dinner
items.text: You walked after 1 of your scored meals, which is too few to see an effect. Walking after dinner went with a smaller rise in sugar, about 18.3 mg/dL smaller.

items.title: Move dinner earlier
items.text: 58.3% of your dinners started at 8 pm or later, and sugar rose about 9.2 mg/dL more after late dinners. Try to start dinner before 8 pm to see how it affects you.

items.title: Aim for a 13-hour overnight break
items.text: Your overnight fast averaged 12.1 hours, and 25.0% of nights reached 13 hours. Adding an overnight fast to coaching changed some numbers, but it's not clear how it affects everyone.
